{{Quote|Sabotaged? No&hellip;Tavoy and Watkins&hellip;wait, look! Ryder is still holding on!''"<br />"''&hellip;not like this&hellip;sir.|Shara and a dying Ryder|<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />}}
'''Ryder''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Grey Squadron]], which was commanded by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X2]]. Ryder was among the Grey Squadron [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who accompanied X2 to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in an [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|effort]] to locate X2's brother, [[X1]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. During the mission, Ryder [[Death/Legends|fell victim]] to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] when the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] were rigged with [[Detonation pack|detpacks]] by [[Unidentified Imperial saboteur|one of X1's Imperials]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What the&mdash;What happened here&hellip;?!''"<br />"''It looks like someone planted detpacks on our ships, sir.|X2 and a member of Grey Squadron|<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />}}
Ryder was a [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Grey Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] unit led by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X2]].<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" /> At some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] and [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Ryder accompanied X2 and the rest of Grey Squadron on a [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, X2 hoped to track down his [[DNA/Legends|genetic]] brother, [[X1]], who had established himself as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and was seeking [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] domination.<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />

Upon arrival to the planet in their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], Grey Squadron decided to land in the middle of the planet's swamps, in order to avoid detection. The squadron soon discovered that X1 possessed a [[X1's Dathomir base|base]] on the surface of Dathomir, and X2 [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that his brother had been working on something important there. However, X1 had left the planet, and his base subsequently came under attack by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]]. Having defeated both the Nightsisters and X1's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], X2 and Grey Squadron member [[Shara]] went inside the base&mdash;which was revealed to contain X1's cloning laboratory&mdash;to retrieve important data from X1's office, leaving Ryder and the other pilots at a landing pad with their starfighters.<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />

[[File:Grey_Squadron_went_boom.jpg|thumb|left|250px|X2 checks on Ryder.]]
However, while X2 and Shara were away, an [[Unidentified Imperial saboteur|Imperial]] loyal to X1 managed to infiltrate the landing site undetected and plant [[Detonation pack|detpacks]] onto the squadron's X-wings. The resulting series of explosions killed most of Grey Squadron and destroyed their starfighters. Ryder himself was mortally wounded, but he survived long enough to see X2 and Shara's return. Grey Squadron captured the saboteur, and X2 [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choked]] him in a gust of anger. He then led the remainder of his squadron in an attack on an [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], destroying it in an act of retaliation.<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ryder appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'', which was published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Battlefront: Elite Squadron (Nintendo)" />
